question: What's the highest the S&P 500 will reach on July 24, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Below 7,375": Wins if the S&P 500 Index (SPX) intraday high on July 24, 2026 during regular trading hours (9:30 AM – 4:00 PM ET) is strictly below 7,375.00.
- "7,375 – 7,449.99": Wins if the S&P 500 Index (SPX) intraday high on July 24, 2026 during regular trading hours is greater than or equal to 7,375.00 and strictly below 7,450.00.
- "7,450 – 7,524.99": Wins if the S&P 500 Index (SPX) intraday high on July 24, 2026 during regular trading hours is greater than or equal to 7,450.00 and strictly below 7,525.00.
- "7,525 – 7,599.99": Wins if the S&P 500 Index (SPX) intraday high on July 24, 2026 during regular trading hours is greater than or equal to 7,525.00 and strictly below 7,600.00.
- "7,600 – 7,674.99": Wins if the S&P 500 Index (SPX) intraday high on July 24, 2026 during regular trading hours is greater than or equal to 7,600.00 and strictly below 7,675.00.
- "7,675 – 7,749.99": Wins if the S&P 500 Index (SPX) intraday high on July 24, 2026 during regular trading hours is greater than or equal to 7,675.00 and strictly below 7,750.00.
- "7,750 or above": Wins if the S&P 500 Index (SPX) intraday high on July 24, 2026 during regular trading hours is greater than or equal to 7,750.00.

Clarifications:
- The intraday high is the highest index value printed during the regular NYSE trading session (9:30 AM – 4:00 PM ET) on July 24, 2026, not pre-market or after-hours activity.

data_sources: S&P Dow Jones Indices (official index publisher)
